notes.title: The Fastest Fist V1.1.0
notes.content:
快拳1.1.0

非常感谢大家对我们游戏的支持，你们的评测和建议对我们很重要，我们会继续完善和改进游戏，欢迎继续提供您宝贵的意见和建议！support@gameart.cn

1.1.0

更新列表：
- 新增10个关卡
- 修复排行榜数据，只提交最好成绩
- 增加了restart和exit按钮，可以在游戏中和游戏结束后返回logo界面重新开始和关闭游戏。
- UI改进：更改了按钮的样式和统计界面、排行榜界面


预告：
我们正在制作一款第一人称VR格斗游戏，将于2016年圣诞节前发布，敬请期待！


The Fastest Fist V1.1.0

Thank for your support! Your reviews and suggestions are very important to us, we'll continue to finish and improve this game, please feel free to leave feedback on the Steam community forum, as a comment on this news post, or by emailing us at support@gameart.cn.

PS: We are working on a new first-person boxing game, of course it is designed for VR, and it'll be published before christmas this year!

Changelog:
- add 10 new levels
- fixed the bug of leaderboard, only the highest score should be displayed in the Leaderboards.
- add RESTART and EXIT buttons, player now could restart and exit from the game
- UI changes: changed the appearance of buttons, Statistics panel and Leaderboards
